{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the response rates by arm without adjustment
response_rate_control = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
response_rate_treatment = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
treatment_effect_raw = response_rate_treatment - response_rate_control

print(f"Raw response rate - control: {response_rate_control:.3f}")
print(f"Raw response rate - treatment: {response_rate_treatment:.3f}")
print(f"Raw treatment effect (diff in proportions): {treatment_effect_raw:.3f}")"}
